verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pomelo processes authorizations and delivers Reversal and Refund transactions through an Adjustments endpoint in production, but nothing documents a sandbox or a simulator for generating authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds or declines. Production handling of these transaction types is an adjacent capability and does not show they can be simulated before a real card is used.

support.subject: As a developer, I can simulate the whole transaction lifecycle in the sandbox — authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, and declines — so my auth logic is tested before a real card ever swipes
